Welcome to the AI Engineer Code Summit Hackathon!

We've teamed up with Meta, Google Deepmind, MongoDB, and Fetch.ai to host a one day hackathon for working on frontier AI engineering problems, the weekend before the official summit.

Co-located with ODSC AI West Conferenc

A dedicated space for 250 exclusive enterprise leaders to validate governance, operationalize agentic automation, and scale AI strategy under intense ROI pressure

The AI X Leadership Summit is a co-located event with the ODSC AI West Conference, taking place in the heart of Silicon Valley.

Why Attend?

Close the Gap: Bridge the divide between high-level C-suite objectives and granular technical realities to accelerate execution.
Stay Ahead of Disruption: Gain the latest insights on emerging AI trends, LLMs, and disruptive tech to position your organization at the forefront of innovation.
Accelerate Team Alignment: Achieve unparalleled internal alignment and rapid decision-making by attending with your core strategy team.
Peer Validation: Validate your roadmap with 250+ VP-level leaders and practitioners in a private, non-competitive setting.

2026 Featured Speakers
Learn from the architects of the modern AI landscape. Our speakers represent the intersection of elite academia, venture-backed builders, and cutting-edge AI research:

Thomas Dohmke, PhD – Co-founder & CEO, Entire
Babak Hodjat, PhD – SVP, Chief AI Officer, Cognizant
Dr. Jon Krohn – Host & Co-Founder, SuperDataScience Podcast | Y Carrot
Chip Huyen – Author, AI Engineering
Peter Norvig – Researcher, Recursive
Michael I. Jordan, PhD – Researcher & Professor Emeritus, Inria | UC Berkeley
Deepak Pathak, PhD – Co-Founder & CEO, Skild AI
Charu Maheshwari – Product Finance & Strategy, Anthropic
Alex Graveley – Director, Comet, Perplexity AI
Nouha Dziri, PhD – Senior Research Scientist, Cohere Labs
Sinan Ozdemir – Head of AI Developer Education | AI & LLM Advisor | Author, Fireworks AI | Tola Capital
Diogo Almeida – CEO & Co-Founder, TypeSafe AI
Marius Hobbhahn – CEO & Founder, Apollo Research
Cal Al-Dhubaib – Principal Technologist, Rubrik
Rocky Yu – Founder & CEO, AGI House

Speakers are announced every week - https://odsc.ai/west/speakers/

The Agenda: Key AI Topics

Work in the Age of AI: Navigate the impact on workforce roles and skills while cultivating growth.
Generative AI: Harness the potential to automate content, design, and executive decision-making.
AI Adoption: Master the strategies for effective integration, efficiency, and competitive edge.
AI Strategy: Develop data-driven plans for enhanced customer experiences and operational ROI.
Ethics & Governance: Chart a course for responsible AI, mitigating bias, and building enterprise trust.
Agents & Automation: Discover transformative LLM-driven agent systems for intelligent automation.

Your Role. Your Action Plan.

Enterprise AI Strategist: CDOs, Chief AI Officers, VPs of Data & Analytics
Product Innovators: CPOs, Directors of Innovation, AI Product Leads, VC Leads
Operations & Infrastructure: COOs, CTOs, VPs of AI Infrastructure, Regulation & Ethics Leads
Technical-Leadership Bridge: AI Architects, MLOps Leads

Location: Hyatt Regency | Burlingame, CA (San Francisco Bay Area)

Registration

Welcome! To join the event, please register below.

About Event

Agenda
6:00 PM: Doors open

6:30 to 7:15 PM: Panel

After that: Free conversation and networking

"The way to get startup ideas is not to try to think of startup ideas. It's to look for problems, preferably problems you have yourself." Paul Graham

Most people who want to build something sit in a room and brainstorm ideas. That is the wrong starting point.

The right starting point is a real problem. That is the ITCH worth scratching.

If you do not have that problem yourself, come find it here. ITCH is a panel discussion with business owners or industry experts in the SF community. We dig into what is actually hard in their business right now. Together, we find the ITCH.

You leave with a list of real problems you can actually work on. And some of the panelists might let you pilot your solution with them directly.You can find ways to leverage AI for these problems.

Industry
We're inviting a San Francisco retail owner who runs a physical clothing store and also designs and manufactures their own clothing line.

ITCHATHON
Two days later we run the ITCHATHON, a hackathon where we solve the problems we found here. Sign up for that too →

This is for anyone who wants to build something. A startup, a side project, or just something for your CV. Up to you.

Come and leave with an ITCH.September 24th, 6 PM
